# Security Policy

Welcome to the Cosmeron Security Policy, covering responsible disclosure and vulnerability reporting. Check the full information here: [Português](../Docs/pt/Governance/SECURITY.md) | [English](../Docs/en/Governance/SECURITY.md) | [Español](../Docs/es/Governance/SECURITY.md)

Sensitive vulnerabilities should be submitted through this repository's **Private vulnerability reporting** feature rather than a public issue.
